body: The Airbus A320 ATRA (Advanced Technology Research Aircraft) has completed its commissioning flights at the Airbus site in Manching, Germany, entering service as a flying test bed for the Eurofighter's next-generation radar. Fitted with a customised Eurofighter nose, the aircraft is owned by the German Aerospace Center (DLR) and will support the continued development of the Eurofighter's new E-Scan radar.

The new radar, the Eurofighter Common Radar System Mk1, is an active electronically scanned array (AESA). Germany's Quadriga and Tranche 5 Eurofighters and Spain's Halcón programme jets will be equipped with it, and retrofitting operational Eurofighters is also planned. Erik Lorch, Head of the E-Scan Mk1 Programme, said the radar greatly enhances the Eurofighter's capabilities in both air-to-air and air-to-ground operations. To carry the Eurofighter nose, the fuselage was reinforced, hundreds of metres of data cables were laid, and a liquid and air cooling system was installed to regulate the radar's temperature; workstations in the cabin give experts real-time access to the radar data.

The structurally modified aircraft first flew in early 2025, still without an active radar, to test its basic airworthiness, followed by extensive ground tests. During the recent commissioning flights, Airbus confirmed that the aircraft and the radar also perform effectively in the air. Sebastian Ritz, who leads the A320 Flying Test Bed Programme at Airbus Defence and Space, said this was the final step in the validation phase and the E-Scan Mk1 flying test bed is now operational. The eye-catching A320 ATRA is set to become a regular fixture on the flight line at Manching.
en.summary: The Airbus A320 ATRA flying laboratory, fitted with a Eurofighter nose, has completed its commissioning flights and is now operational as a test bed for the Eurofighter's new E-Scan radar.
en.title: Airbus A320 flying radar lab with Eurofighter nose completes commissioning flights

body: 空中巴士A320 ATRA先進技術研究機已在德國曼興的空中巴士廠區完成驗證飛行，正式成為颱風戰機新一代雷達的飛行測試平台。這架飛機機頭裝有特製的颱風戰機鼻錐，由德國航太中心（DLR）擁有，將支援颱風戰機新型E-Scan雷達的持續研發。

新型雷達名為颱風戰機通用雷達系統Mk1，屬於主動電子掃描陣列雷達。德國Quadriga與Tranche 5批次以及西班牙Halcón計畫的新造颱風戰機將配備此型雷達，未來也計畫為現役颱風戰機換裝。E-Scan Mk1計畫負責人艾瑞克·洛爾奇表示，這款雷達將大幅提升颱風戰機在空對空與空對地作戰的能力。為裝上颱風戰機鼻錐，機身經過結構強化，鋪設數百公尺數據線纜，並加裝液冷與氣冷系統為雷達降溫；機艙內設有多個工作站，可即時取得雷達資訊。
這架結構改裝後的飛機於2025年初首飛，當時尚未裝載主動雷達，僅驗證基本適航性，隨後進行大量地面測試。在最近的驗證飛行中，空中巴士確認飛機與雷達在空中均有效運作；空中巴士防衛與太空A320飛行測試平台計畫負責人塞巴斯蒂安·里茨表示，這是驗證階段的最後一步，E-Scan Mk1飛行測試平台現已投入運作。這架外型醒目的A320 ATRA日後將成為曼興廠區飛行線上的常客。
zh.summary: 空中巴士與德國航太中心合作的A320 ATRA飛行實驗室完成驗證飛行，機頭裝有颱風戰機鼻錐，將用於測試颱風戰機新一代E-Scan雷達。
zh.title: 空中巴士A320颱風戰機鼻錐雷達實驗室完成驗證飛行，正式投入運作
